title: chromolaena frustrata
intro: Chromolaena frustrata, commonly known as Eupatorium, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. Eupatorium has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents responsible for Eupatorium's medicinal properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
